title: qa(authz-conformance), docs(api): record that `POST /api/v1/keys` mints only for a signed-in session, as a matrix row and a one-line docs mention (follow-up to #27536)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** The maintainer, in the PM session `session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk` on 2026-10-29, said (verbatim): 「其他任务正常提交 issue」. This card carries the two Acceptance-notes follow-ups of PR #27536 (merged), filed as a normal card.

Business reason: since #27536, `POST /api/v1/keys` mints a key only for a caller admitted by a signed-in session; a request admitted by an API key gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. The authz-conformance matrix and the API-key docs do not yet say so. The PR's "Acceptance notes" name both as follow-ups owed by the dispatching seat, and the seat's ACCEPT (comment 6502597025) says: "Two Acceptance-notes follow-ups (an authz-conformance matrix row and a docs one-liner) stay with the dispatching seat, per the notes." Without them, a script author reading the docs learns of the rule only from the 403.
Reader: the dev who takes this card from the queue (`packages/qa/dogfood` and `content/docs`).
Dedupe: searched the open and closed issues (GitHub issue search scoped to `objectstack-ai/objectstack`) for "api keys mint session required authz-conformance matrix docs" (4 hits) and "POST /api/v1/keys API key cannot mint another key session only docs" (8 hits). None covers either item.

## What to change

### 1. Authz-conformance matrix row

The PR's Acceptance note: "`packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts`: the `anonymous-deny-keys` row's note says "a signed-in caller reaches the mint exactly as before", which is still true for a session. This PR adds no row for the session requirement (outside this dispatch's file surface)."

At `origin/main` `a75ddba1`:
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts:336–339`: the `anonymous-deny-keys` row. Its `enforcement` ends "and a signed-in caller reaches the mint exactly as before".
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts:140–146`: the session check, `context.admission?.credential !== 'session'` refused, after the anonymous decision and before the body is read.
- Pins: `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys-mint-interactive-session.pin.test.ts` (14 cases).

The ask: add one row beside `anonymous-deny-keys` for the session-required rule (state `enforced`, `enforcement` naming `keys.ts` and the positive `credential === 'session'` check, `covers` and `note` in the matrix's own conventions, `note` naming the pin file). Change the `anonymous-deny-keys` row's "a signed-in caller" to "a session-admitted caller", so the two rows agree.

### 2. Docs one-liner

The PR's Acceptance note: "The docs that teach minting (`content/docs/api/index.mdx`, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`) already show session-based minting. None of them says a key cannot mint. A one-line mention there is a follow-up."

At `origin/main` `a75ddba1`, the page that should carry it is `content/docs/api/index.mdx:68`, the **API key** bullet ("mint one with `POST /api/v1/keys` (the key is shown once), or from the **Connect an Agent** page …"). Add one sentence there: minting needs a signed-in session, and a request authenticated with an API key is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. If the same sentence also fits under "Or mint one over REST:" at `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx:121`, add it there too. `client-sdk.mdx:176` is a table row and needs no change.

Out of scope: any runtime change, which shipped in #27536.
